headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of October 23, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming SPY with an average return of 23.19% compared to SPY's 12.23%. This translates to an average alpha of 10.96%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also ahead of the benchmark. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 42.53%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has seen a slight decline of 2.91%. This outperformance against SPY is particularly relevant during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's performance. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
